Subject: Activate supplier payout channels — bank letter + PO tag mapping

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for completing the vendor portal intake. We're ready to activate Arcadia's payout channels but need the following to finalize enrollment and map invoices to PO 84217: 

- A bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account name and IBAN/ABA routing details (PDF).
- A signed W-9 or W-8 (as applicable) for our records.
- Confirmation of preferred payout rails (ACH domestic, wire, or virtual account) and whether you require a remittance string on the invoice.
- A sample invoice showing the invoice field you want us to use for PO/Reference (or a CSV with invoice_id -> PO mapping).

If you can upload the documents to the vendor portal link below or reply with the attachments, we'll run a quick verification and schedule the micro-deposit test. Targeting first remittance the week of Jun 23 if everything looks good.

Portal: https://vendor-portal.arcadia-supply.com/uploads

Thanks — cc'ing FinOps (Priya) and PayOps (Jonas) to keep approvals and mapping aligned.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

Hi Olga —

Thanks, we uploaded the documents to the portal and I'm attaching copies here for quick reference. Per your checklist: 

- Attached: Arcadia_BankLetter.pdf (bank letter on HSBC letterhead confirming account name and IBAN).
- Attached: Arcadia_W9_signed.pdf (signed W-9).
- Preferred payout method: ACH (domestic) for US-based orders; wire as fallback for international remits.
- Invoice tagging: we can include "PO" in the invoice_number field and also provide a sample CSV if helpful.

We don't store sensitive account numbers in emails, but the bank letter contains the masked account ending (***1234) and full ABA/IBAN. If you need a copy signed/sealed by bank branch, I can request that and follow up.

Let me know if anything else is required to get the micro-deposit scheduled.

Best,
